content: Zae boꞌaḡano ekalesia ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mazao eḡeꞌa inare ziꞌohe. Eḡe zuni ekalesia ibitoziꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoga, zu Keriso aduga horonadu rae fureneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa, ebu Kerisoꞌa niḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa fureniteꞌe madaḡano ani teite ni ḡihiꞌaḡa dainiteꞌe vazeḡa.

Badiꞌa mamoe taufoꞌi. Zeꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zae ꞌevoreo tiroteꞌe azaḡa uꞌano, faine ḡiazoꞌi. Zaeꞌa haḡae huniteꞌe gauḡa radu ago ꞌouge haḡaoꞌi, rehano Badiꞌaꞌa urateꞌeteꞌe teige zaeꞌa uratadu matuꞌe haḡaoꞌi. Mene hadi ubumaḡa reifine, rehano ze danazifine ꞌouge haḡaoꞌi.
Badiꞌaꞌa zae ziniroteꞌe azaḡa ago zuhiꞌazoꞌi, rehano zae mamoeꞌa za tuhutuhuzifine haḡai manoḡa ihozoꞌi.
ꞌOugine, mamoe taufeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaniꞌa ariteꞌe madaḡano zaeꞌa kini vadiga adiriḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa hidiꞌuma. Aꞌe mene hauḡiteꞌe ḡauḡa.
Eꞌe teige, tahiꞌa izigaiziga, ekalesia ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa
egozenoꞌi. Zae niduꞌa nize mae ovoeꞌenaꞌa vaze ꞌahogaꞌahoga gubazeꞌeteꞌe dabuaḡa vidanoꞌi. Mazaḡa Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae raꞌohe,

content.text: “Badiꞌaꞌa iniu zeḡeꞌa bare nize mae iteꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe agiroziꞌohe,
rehano nize mae ovoeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mazaoꞌe manoḡa fureneꞌohe.”

content: Eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌa ꞌevore gigiꞌaḡa ꞌuꞌuḡano za zaeꞌa bare nize mae ovoroꞌi. ꞌOugine, aniꞌa ohoniroteꞌe madaḡano nize mae itiꞌuma.
Zamaze aduga niduꞌa Badiꞌa ꞌevoreo toꞌi, mazaḡa aniꞌe zae taufeꞌohe.
Zaeꞌa bare haḡai sauꞌa hezahohanoꞌi zu tohutohe radoꞌi. Laioniꞌa ḡunaꞌe ragaveꞌeteꞌe teige, agireze Diaboloꞌa vaze ꞌahoga manadu unoga veize vaze vaḡe ragaveꞌohe.
Fieꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano edau gigaruꞌenaꞌa, Diabolo teite utitoꞌi. Mazaḡa za edeḡa, zae nego nabudi raha niduꞌa zamaḡano radiuꞌeteꞌeꞌa zuni zaeꞌa hideꞌeteꞌe adugaḡa idane hideꞌohe.

Za mada tahiḡa aduga hidiroteꞌe enogano, Badiꞌa aneꞌa bare zae manohuziꞌuma, edeze gigaziꞌuma, inaraziꞌuma, zu ohoze gigaziꞌuma. Aniꞌe zae mazao manoḡa niduꞌa fureneꞌeteꞌe Badiꞌaḡa. Aniꞌa zae huzadu zaeꞌa Keriso teite tiburaro, ebu Badiꞌa ni ḡihiꞌaḡa radiu tuḡutuḡu zae teite dainiro.

Soꞌa futuꞌa ꞌadiꞌe Silasiꞌa danahadu zae veize mirihiro. Aniꞌe eḡe nego zu zamaḡa niduꞌa hina gaueꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa rae e zamareꞌohe. Soꞌa ꞌahaonoꞌo e zae inaraziꞌohe zu ꞌahiꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa emeḡe mazao fureneꞌeteꞌe manoḡaḡa hune rae fureneꞌohe. Zaꞌe ane manoḡa eꞌe zamaḡano edau gigaranoꞌi.
Babulonia habaꞌano zae nabudi ekalesia azaḡaniꞌa zae mazao uhiu ḡoeꞌa tuḡureꞌohe. Zeꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zae teite ohotiroteꞌe azaḡa. Ebu eḡe ubude Mareko zuni zae mazao uhiu ḡoeꞌa tuḡureꞌohe.
Zamarotiteꞌenaꞌa, kavarotitadu “Manoḡahe?” rae unihoꞌi. Zaꞌe Keriso teite tiburaroteꞌe azaḡa. Badiꞌaꞌa zae niduꞌa zama roḡeḡa ziniꞌenoꞌi.
